qualification_claim: none; temporal field interpolation feasibility canary only
material_reliability: not established by numerical support diagnostics
resume_policy: resume the same attempt from immutable v3 checkpoint generations; never restart under a different temporal policy

parameter_binding.source_policy: independent geometric seeds_f3(512), continuous x<0/x>=0 labels; native particle identity never defines a seed
parameter_binding.reference_field_policy: componentwise linear interpolation of native position/velocity/mass/density arrays at the two selected saved frames bracketing the current interval
parameter_binding.interval_boundary_policy: stage times outside the current registered interval are rejected; no extrapolation and no following-frame access
parameter_binding.model_source_policy: model CFD state and future model fields are forbidden; only the registered reference source H5 is opened
parameter_binding.trajectory_policy: native particle positions are linearly interpolated as support geometry; the tracer path is the independent RK4 state and is not read from native particle labels
parameter_binding.support_mask_policy: the valid fluid native row mask must match at both interval endpoints
parameter_binding.original_material_gate: retained as comparison metadata only; no gate or 1% threshold change

runner.snapshot_policy: root must create and bind an immutable runtime snapshot before queueing

recovery_design.hdf5_commit_order: append frame, flush/fsync, publish immutable content-addressed NPZ generation, atomically replace manifest, then record manifest attribute
recovery_design.fault_window_covered: SIGKILL after generation publication and before manifest replacement
recovery_design.resume_source_of_truth: last manifest generation; any extra HDF5 row is truncated to that committed frame
recovery_design.generation_gc: none in this canary; retain all generations for audit

development_test_profile.scope: analytic and checkpoint unit tests only; not a real-source scaling measurement

v3_estimate.basis: v2 0.2 s/512/s2 measured profile plus endpoint-pair field-array interpolation and extra temporal provenance checks; no v3 measurement is claimed

comparison_role.primary: isolate current-frame-held RK4 versus interval-bounded linear reference-field time dependence
comparison_role.paired_baseline: existing F3 v1/v2 current-frame traces remain immutable and are not overwritten
comparison_role.interpretation: any CDF, residence, return, or unknown change is diagnostic only; it cannot be assigned to temporal interpolation alone without a common spatial/reference comparison

status_notes: Proposal has not been submitted to the central runtime and does not mutate the ledger.
This .2 s canary is not a full-window F3 qualification run.
Existing dense/.01 and dense/.002 jobs are independent and are not restarted or reused as v3 outputs.
